name: CLAMBER
description: CLAMBER is a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' effectiveness in identifying and clarifying ambiguous user queries. It contains approximately 12,000 high-quality data items organized through a taxonomy spanning input understanding and task completion perspectives across three primary dimensions and eight fine-grained categories.
reputation: Comprehensive benchmark revealing limited practical utility of current LLMs in handling ambiguous queries
notes: Current LLMs fall short in generating high-quality clarifying questions due to lack of conflict resolution and inaccurate utilization of inherent knowledge; taxonomy covers both input understanding and task completion perspectives.
